baseline_models.reading: The Lord creates the human from an origin that is both clinging and clotted: the focus states a created human whose beginning is dependent material rather than self-originating.

focus_anchor.role: The focus directly joins the act of creating the human to the مِنْ-origin phrase headed by عَلَقٍ.

activation_trace.role: The creation image supplies bringing the human into being.
The human-presence image identifies the created object as the human person or kind.
The clinging image makes the origin dependent or attached rather than self-standing.
The clotted-blood image supplies the ordinary concrete material sense of عَلَقٍ.

baseline_models.mechanism: The verb خَلَقَ takes الإنسان as its object and مِنْ عَلَقٍ as the source or origin, so the clinging/clotted image modifies the human's beginning rather than becoming a separate topic.
baseline_models.reader_inference: The packet supplies the focus wording, QAC roots, and the selected branch images. Reading مِنْ as an origin relation and combining the B001 and B003 images is an ordinary syntax-and-lexicon inference; no additional directional assumption is needed. Other ع ل ق branches remain live but are not promoted here.
baseline_models.containment: Keep this as an origin statement about the human and its lexical image; do not turn it into a complete biological account or claim that every mapped ع ل ق branch is simultaneously intended.

context_deltas.reading: The created-from-علق human is introduced as the addressee of reading under the name of the creating Lord, so the origin statement becomes the ground of a commanded relation to its creator.

focus_anchor.role: The human's created, clinging origin is the element that the preceding command now frames.

activation_trace.role: The reading/recitation image turns the focus into the object of an instruction to read.
The lordship image gives the named ربّ the agency and authority associated with the creation verb.
The repeated creation image explicitly carries the creator reference into the preceding clause.

structural_cues.role: The imperative, name phrase, lordship noun, and relative creation clause precede the focus and frame its origin relationally.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding imperative and بِٱسْمِ construction attach the focus's creation to a named ربّ: the same human who has a dependent origin is addressed through reading in the creator's name.

changed_reading.before: The focus alone presents a human created from a clinging or clotted origin.
changed_reading.after: The origin is also the entry point into reading under the name and authority of the creating Lord.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the reading, lordship, and repeated-creation images and their in-window order. The claim that بِٱسْمِ frames the command by the creator's agency is a direct syntactic/sequence inference; a purely material reading of the focus remains live.
context_deltas.containment: Do not infer a full doctrine of revelation or identify an addressee beyond the wording. The delta only says that the preceding clause relationally frames the focus origin.

context_deltas.reading: The human's clinging or clotted origin is followed by repeated reading and teaching through the pen, giving the focus an in-window trajectory from created matter to learned capacity.

focus_anchor.role: The created human from عَلَقٍ is the starting point for the later teaching sequence.

activation_trace.role: The repeated reading image extends the command begun before the focus.
The lordship image keeps the teaching source in the register of ربّ.
The generosity/nobility image qualifies the Lord in the teaching frame.
The knowledge image makes teaching the explicit transition applied to the human.
The writing-reed image supplies the concrete instrument associated with teaching.
The complete repeated occurrence joins teaching at the start of the ayah to knowing at its end.
The human image shows that the taught recipient is the same human category named in the focus.

structural_cues.role: A second reading imperative and the superlative Lord description continue the focus's opening frame.
The relative clause specifies teaching and names the pen as its instrument.
The repeated teaching verb and the contrast with what the human did not know make the capacity-change explicit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repetition of اقْرَأْ and عَلَّمَ, followed by the pen and the contrast مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ, links the focus's origin to a process by which the created human receives knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The focus is an origin statement about a clinging or clotted substance.
changed_reading.after: That origin is the first stage of a sequence in which the human is addressed, taught by the pen, and moved from not-knowing toward knowledge.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated reading/teaching roots, the pen branch, the human occurrence, and the exact sequence. Reading the adjacent ayat as a progression is a text-backed structural inference; the content of what was taught and the biological detail of عَلَقٍ remain alternatives not settled here.
context_deltas.containment: Keep the change to the local origin-to-teaching sequence. Do not claim that the branch inventory proves a universal theory of human development or that every knowledge sense of ع ل م is active.

context_deltas.reading: The created human's clinging origin is later contrasted with a human who sees himself self-sufficient and therefore transgresses; the stated return to the Lord reverses that imagined independence.

focus_anchor.role: The dependent origin supplies the counterpoint to the later claim of self-sufficiency.

activation_trace.role: The focus's clinging image makes dependence the baseline against which later independence is measured.
The repeated human image carries the focus's human subject into the warning.
The transgression image supplies the overstepping that follows the human's imagined sufficiency.
The seeing image grounds the subject's perception of himself.
The self-sufficiency/wealth image supplies the perceived condition that triggers the warning.
The lordship image identifies the relation to which the subject returns.
The return image supplies the reversal of apparent self-sufficiency.

structural_cues.role: كَلَّآ rejects the preceding frame while إنّ and the emphatic verb mark the warning about the human.
The causal-looking أن-clause explicitly connects transgression to seeing oneself self-sufficient.
The emphatic return-to-Lord clause closes the contrast with a compulsory relational endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence names self-perceived sufficiency as the condition accompanying transgression, then places return to ربّ after it; that reversal activates the focus's clinging origin as a limit on the claim of independence.

changed_reading.before: The human is introduced through a dependent clinging or clotted origin.
changed_reading.after: The same human is portrayed as capable of imagining self-sufficiency and transgressing, yet still bound to return to the Lord.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the human repetition, transgression, seeing, self-sufficiency, lordship, and return images, while the sequence supplies the stated relation between them. Treating the return as a reversal of imagined independence is a local structural inference; other ع ل ق senses remain live.
context_deltas.containment: This is a rhetorical contrast in the supplied window, not a universal psychological law. Do not infer that the focus's material image alone proves the later causal account.

context_deltas.reading: The created human is placed in a social and moral test: an obstructive person confronts a servant's prayer, while guidance and taqwa stand against denial and turning away under divine seeing.

focus_anchor.role: The created human named in the focus is the category whose conduct and accountability the later alternatives develop.

activation_trace.role: The أرأيت formula image marks the repeated prompt to assess the case.
The restraint image supplies the obstructive act under examination.
The worship/submissive-obedience image specifies the servant's relation.
The prescribed-worship image makes prayer the act being obstructed.
The guidance image supplies the positive alternative in the first أرأيت scenario.
The command/directive image supplies the servant's possible call to taqwa.
The self-protective caution image supplies the taqwa alternative.
The falsehood image supplies the negative alternative.
The turning-away image completes the negative alternative.
The seeing image grounds the final claim that the divine subject sees.

structural_cues.role: The first repeated أرأيت prompt introduces the one who restrains.
The object of restraint is a servant in the act of prayer.
The second prompt sets guidance as a counter-case.
The coordinated alternative adds commanding taqwa to the positive case.
The third prompt reverses the prior alternatives into denial and turning away.
The closing question places all of the contrasted conduct under divine seeing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated أرأيت questions and the paired alternatives of guidance/taqwa versus denial/turning-away convert the focus's created human into an accountable servant, while the final يرى clause supplies the observing horizon.

changed_reading.before: The human is primarily an entity whose created origin is described.
changed_reading.after: The created human is also a servant whose prayer, guidance, command, denial, and withdrawal are tested under divine seeing.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated prompt, restraint, worship, guidance, command, taqwa, falsehood, turning-away, and seeing images. The inference that the alternatives form an accountability test follows from the wording and sequence; the identity of الذي ينهى is materially unresolved.
context_deltas.containment: Do not identify a historical antagonist or derive a legal ruling from this delta. It concerns the local contrast between obstruction, worship, guidance, and denial.

context_deltas.reading: The apparent social power of the obstructive human is reversed by a threat to seize the forelock: his council's summons is answered by a stronger summons, making created dependence an accountability limit on human power.

focus_anchor.role: The focus's dependent created human is the subject whose later grasping and loss of social control are contrasted.

activation_trace.role: The focus clinging image supplies a dependence baseline for the later seizure reversal.
The restraint image is repeated in the conditional demand that the person desist.
The forelock-seizing image supplies the threatened physical reversal.
The forelock image identifies the point at which control is exercised.
The repeated forelock image carries the threatened object into the characterization.
The falsehood image qualifies the forelock's owner.
The culpable-wrongdoing image adds the moral qualification.
The calling image supplies the human's attempt to summon his support.
The council/gathering image specifies the social body he calls.
The repeated calling image marks the answering summons.
The pushing/repelling image gives the answering group a forceful counter-image.

structural_cues.quote_ar: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
structural_cues.role: The rejection, conditional, and emphatic threat move from restraint to seizure of the forelock.
The forelock is directly characterized by falsehood and culpable error.
The imperative invites the person to call his council.
The answering future summons reverses the expected balance of support.

context_deltas.mechanism: The passage juxtaposes seizure of the forelock with calling a council and then replaces that human call with an answering call; the sequence converts apparent social leverage into exposure to a stronger force.

changed_reading.before: The human's dependent origin is stated without a social power scene.
changed_reading.after: The same created human's attempted support network is subordinated to a threatened grasp and counter-summons.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the forelock, seizure, falsehood, error, calling, council, and pushing images. Reading فليدع مقابل سندع as a social-power reversal is a direct sequence/contrast inference; the precise referent and nature of الزبانية are not expanded beyond the packet.
context_deltas.containment: Keep this as a textual reversal of summons and control. Do not infer a historical council, identify the punished person, or add details about the summoned group.

context_deltas.reading: The human's clinging origin is completed by a behavioral pivot: do not obey the obstructive human, prostrate, and draw near, turning dependence into enacted submission and approach to the Lord.

focus_anchor.role: The dependent origin is revisited as the background for the final commanded orientation.

activation_trace.role: The clinging image supplies the relational baseline that the final approach reorients.
The obedience image is used negatively in لا تطعه, rejecting the obstructive person's command.
The prostration/submission image supplies the positive commanded action.
The devotional-approach image makes اقترب a movement toward nearness to God.

structural_cues.role: The rejection is followed by coordinated prohibitive and positive imperatives, ending in approach.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final coordination redirects obedience away from the obstructive human and toward prostration and approach; the focus's clinging origin thereby gains a text-backed behavioral counterpart in chosen nearness.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes how the human begins from a clinging or clotted origin.
changed_reading.after: The human is directed to enact a different dependence by refusing the obstructive command, prostrating, and approaching.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the obedience, prostration, and devotional-nearness images and the final imperative sequence. Reading the coordinated commands as a directional pivot is ordinary syntax; the focus may still be read only as a material-origin statement.
context_deltas.containment: Do not claim that عَلَقٍ literally means worship or approach. The connection is a later structural activation of the focus, not a replacement translation.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: As a deliberately non-ordinary lexical resonance, the focus's عَلَقٍ can let the human be imagined as vulnerable to a calamity that catches a person; the later forelock seizure and forceful summons make that caughtness echo in the surrounding passage.

focus_anchor.role: The focus's origin phrase is the exact site where the branch-distant caught-by-calamity image is tested.

activation_trace.role: The branch image of a calamity or death catching a person supplies the surprising caughtness resonance.
The seizure-by-forelock image gives the context an actual catching or grasping action.
The forelock/taking image specifies what is caught.
The pushing/repelling image reinforces a forceful consequence rather than ordinary origin description.

structural_cues.role: The emphatic threat provides a concrete later image of being seized.
The counter-summons supplies the surrounding punitive pressure that makes the caughtness echo possible.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: A branch-distant image from the focus root is activated by later, text-backed seizure and force: an origin phrase is made to resonate with vulnerability to being caught by consequences.

changed_reading.before: The ordinary focus reading is a clinging or clotted source from which the human is created.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the same root also lets the created human's origin echo as a condition vulnerable to being caught by a later calamity or grasp.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The packet supplies the B014 caught-by-calamity image and the later forelock/seizure branches. The proposed foreshadowing or cross-domain echo is entirely reader-supplied; the ordinary B003 clotted and B001 clinging readings remain materially live, and no additional lexical equivalence is claimed.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it moves from material origin to consequence and uses a non-primary branch. Treat it only as an exploratory metaphorical resonance, never as the literal translation of عَلَقٍ or as tafsir.

summary.ordinary_reading: 96:2 ordinarily states that the Lord created the human from عَلَقٍ, with the supplied branches supporting a clinging and clotted origin; it is an origin claim, not a complete account.
coexisting_readings: The preceding and following opening ayat place that created human under the Lord's named command to read and teaching through the pen.
The same human is contrasted with imagined self-sufficiency and transgression, then redirected toward return, worship, and approach.
The later forelock-and-council sequence adds a reversal of social power while leaving the ordinary material-origin reading intact.
unresolved_limits: source_gaps is an empty object in the packet, and the orientation is non-citable; the mapped branches are unranked lexical possibilities rather than tafsir.
The exact referent of ٱلَّذِى يَنْهَىٰ and the full scope of later punitive terms are not resolved by this window.
The B014 caughtness resonance is exploratory only; the clotted and clinging readings remain the ordinary alternatives, and no external or biological claim is established.

variant.scope_en: Religious or moral guarding of oneself: اتقاء, تقوى, تقاة, تقية, and تقي, including guarding oneself from God, fire, sin, or feared harm.

citation.role: The falsehood image supplies the negative alternative.

variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الكذب في القول والفعل، ووصف صاحبه بالكاذب والكذاب والكذوب، وجمع الأكاذيب والمكاذب
variant.scope_en: Falsehood in speech or action, including liar descriptions and false tales or excuses

citation.role: The turning-away image completes the negative alternative.

variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه ولى الرجل إذا أدبر، وتولى عنه إذا أعرض، والتولي عن الأمر بترك القرب والإصغاء والامتثال
variant.scope_en: Includes turning back, retreating, averting oneself, and refusing attention or compliance.

citation.role: The seeing image grounds the final claim that the divine subject sees.

variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه إدراك المرئي بالحاسة وما يجري مجراها والنظر بعين أو بصيرة
variant.scope_en: Includes sensory seeing and perception by the eye or by insight

citation.role: The first repeated أرأيت prompt introduces the one who restrains.
The object of restraint is a servant in the act of prayer.
The second prompt sets guidance as a counter-case.
The coordinated alternative adds commanding taqwa to the positive case.
The third prompt reverses the prior alternatives into denial and turning away.
The closing question places all of the contrasted conduct under divine seeing.
The focus clinging image supplies a dependence baseline for the later seizure reversal.

variant.image_en: something clinging or hanging on another thing
variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه علق بالشيء ونشب به، وتعليق الشيء أو الباب، وما يعلق عليه أو به كالمعلاق والعلاقة ومعاليق العقد والسوط والقربة.
variant.scope_en: This includes something clinging to, sticking in, hanging from, or being mounted by another thing, including hangers, straps, fasteners, and mounted doors.

citation.role: The restraint image is repeated in the conditional demand that the person desist.

branches.source_ayah_ar: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ

variant.scope_ar: النهي عن الشيء والزجر عنه وكف الفاعل أو انكفافه وتناهي الناس عن المنكر
variant.scope_en: forbidding or restraining someone from something, including ceasing and mutual forbidding

citation.role: The forelock-seizing image supplies the threatened physical reversal.

branches.source_ayah_ar: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ

variant.scope_ar: أخذ مقدم الرأس أو الناصية باليد وما يتبع ذلك من قهر وإذلال
variant.scope_en: Includes taking by the front of the head or forelock, with coercive or humiliating force.

citation.role: The forelock image identifies the point at which control is exercised.

branches.source_ayah_ar: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ

variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه قصاص الشعر ومنبته في مقدم الرأس والقبض على الناصية ومدها والجذب بها والمناصاة والتمكن المجازي بالأخذ بالناصية
variant.scope_en: It covers the forelock or front hairline, seizing or pulling it, mutual forelock-grappling, and figurative control by taking the forelock.

citation.role: The repeated forelock image carries the threatened object into the characterization.

variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه قصاص الشعر ومنبته في مقدم الرأس والقبض على الناصية ومدها والجذب بها والمناصاة والتمكن المجازي بالأخذ بالناصية
variant.scope_en: It covers the forelock or front hairline, seizing or pulling it, mutual forelock-grappling, and figurative control by taking the forelock.

citation.role: The falsehood image qualifies the forelock's owner.

variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الكذب في القول والفعل، ووصف صاحبه بالكاذب والكذاب والكذوب، وجمع الأكاذيب والمكاذب
variant.scope_en: Falsehood in speech or action, including liar descriptions and false tales or excuses

citation.role: The culpable-wrongdoing image adds the moral qualification.

variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الخطء والخطيئة بمعنى الذنب والإثم، والخاطئ القاصد للذنب أو المتعمد لما لا ينبغي، وما يسمى خطيئة وسيئة في باب المؤاخذة
variant.scope_en: Includes sin, guilt, culpable wrongdoing, the intentional sinner, and خطيئة where it is treated as blameworthy wrongdoing.

citation.role: The calling image supplies the human's attempt to summon his support.

variant.image_en: calling to draw near by voice or speech
variant.scope_ar: الدعاء والنداء والإمالة إلى الشيء بصوت وكلام والدعوة إلى الطعام وقصد المكان بدعائه مجازا
variant.scope_en: calling, inviting, or drawing something toward oneself by voice or speech, including invitation to food and metaphorical attraction toward a place

citation.role: The council/gathering image specifies the social body he calls.

variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه النادي والندى والندوة والمنتدى بمعنى مجلس القوم ومتحدثهم ومكان اجتماعهم، ويدخل فيه الجلوس والمشاورة وحضور الندي، ويدخل فيه أهل النادي أو العشيرة إذا سمي المكان بهم.
variant.scope_en: This covers a council, meeting-place, gathering for consultation or conversation, attendance at the assembly, and by metonymy the people of the النادي.

citation.role: The repeated calling image marks the answering summons.

variant.image_en: calling to draw near by voice or speech
variant.scope_ar: الدعاء والنداء والإمالة إلى الشيء بصوت وكلام والدعوة إلى الطعام وقصد المكان بدعائه مجازا
variant.scope_en: calling, inviting, or drawing something toward oneself by voice or speech, including invitation to food and metaphorical attraction toward a place

citation.role: The pushing/repelling image gives the answering group a forceful counter-image.

variant.scope_ar: الدفع عن الشيء والصدم والمنع والممانعة عن النفس أو الجانب ومنه الناقة الزبون والحرب الزبون والرجل ذو الزبونة
variant.scope_en: Physical or forceful pushing away, collision, prevention, and defensive resistance, including the kicking she-camel, striking war, and a self-protecting person.

citation.quote_ar: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
citation.role: The rejection, conditional, and emphatic threat move from restraint to seizure of the forelock.

structural_cues.source_ayah_ar: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ

citation.role: The forelock is directly characterized by falsehood and culpable error.
The imperative invites the person to call his council.
The answering future summons reverses the expected balance of support.
The clinging image supplies the relational baseline that the final approach reorients.

variant.image_en: something clinging or hanging on another thing
variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه علق بالشيء ونشب به، وتعليق الشيء أو الباب، وما يعلق عليه أو به كالمعلاق والعلاقة ومعاليق العقد والسوط والقربة.
variant.scope_en: This includes something clinging to, sticking in, hanging from, or being mounted by another thing, including hangers, straps, fasteners, and mounted doors.

citation.role: The obedience image is used negatively in لا تطعه, rejecting the obstructive person's command.

variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الطوع والطاعة والانقياد للأمر والمضي له، والطائع والمطيع والمطواع والمنقاد، وما كان طوع اليد أو العنان أو القياد أو اللسان بمعنى السلاسة والتبعية
variant.scope_en: Yielding, obedience, compliance with a command, and tractable readiness such as being under the hand, rein, lead, or tongue.

citation.role: The prostration/submission image supplies the positive commanded action.

variant.scope_ar: السجود والخضوع والتذلل ووضع الجبهة بالأرض وسجود الطاعة والتسخير
variant.scope_en: Acts or states of prostration, humbled lowering, obedient submission, placing the forehead on the ground, and voluntary or compelled submission.

citation.role: The devotional-approach image makes اقترب a movement toward nearness to God.

variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه القربة والقربات والتقرب إلى الله والقربان والنسيكة والذبيحة وكل ما يتوسل به طالبا القربة
variant.scope_en: Includes devotional nearness, acts or offerings by which one seeks nearness to God, qurban, sacrifice, and any devotional means of approach.

citation.role: The rejection is followed by coordinated prohibitive and positive imperatives, ending in approach.
The branch image of a calamity or death catching a person supplies the surprising caughtness resonance.

variant.image_en: a calamity or death that catches a person
variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه العلق فلق بمعنى الداهية، العلق بمعنى الدواهي أو الأشغال، والعلوق بمعنى المنية التي تعلَق بالإنسان.
variant.scope_en: This includes a calamity, inescapable trouble, or death described as something that catches onto a person.

citation.role: The seizure-by-forelock image gives the context an actual catching or grasping action.

branches.source_ayah_ar: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ

variant.scope_ar: أخذ مقدم الرأس أو الناصية باليد وما يتبع ذلك من قهر وإذلال
variant.scope_en: Includes taking by the front of the head or forelock, with coercive or humiliating force.

citation.role: The forelock/taking image specifies what is caught.

branches.source_ayah_ar: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ

variant.scope_ar: يدخل فيه قصاص الشعر ومنبته في مقدم الرأس والقبض على الناصية ومدها والجذب بها والمناصاة والتمكن المجازي بالأخذ بالناصية
variant.scope_en: It covers the forelock or front hairline, seizing or pulling it, mutual forelock-grappling, and figurative control by taking the forelock.

citation.role: The pushing/repelling image reinforces a forceful consequence rather than ordinary origin description.

variant.scope_ar: الدفع عن الشيء والصدم والمنع والممانعة عن النفس أو الجانب ومنه الناقة الزبون والحرب الزبون والرجل ذو الزبونة
variant.scope_en: Physical or forceful pushing away, collision, prevention, and defensive resistance, including the kicking she-camel, striking war, and a self-protecting person.

citation.role: The emphatic threat provides a concrete later image of being seized.

structural_cues.source_ayah_ar: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ

citation.role: The counter-summons supplies the surrounding punitive pressure that makes the caughtness echo possible.
